title: Mixed Event — Doll Festival at the Tenma's — Episode4 A Surprise?!

meta.Event Outline: It's the first Doll Festival since Saki returned to school! In the midst of his enthusiastic preparations, Tsukasa looks back on a bitter childhood memory. He then executes his plan to do something special for Saki, but will it go as he hopes...?!

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for your help today, Toya. Especially considering I've been keeping you from reading the book you bought earlier...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, please don't mind that. I'm glad I could be of service.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm? Wait, over there... Is that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Tsukasa! And Toya!
Welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, if it isn't Saki and the gang.
Here for a visit?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hello, Tsukasa.
Oh, and this is...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, meet Toya. He's my junior and was helping me out with some shopping today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya, this is Ichika, Honami and Shiho.
They're Saki's childhood friends.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Pleased to meet you all.
My name is Toya.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, yes. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He seems much more down-to-earth compared to Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho, let's keep that to ourselves...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it looks like you got a lot of stuff, Tsukasa! What exactly were you out buying?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, they're all Doll Festival party goods!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, all of it?! Whoa!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Tsukasa takes such good care of Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That I can't deny.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This party should be a lot of fun. Right, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And thank you for helping Tsukasa today, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were indeed a big help! Again, thank you! And see you at school!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it was nothing. It was fun to help out. Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Tsukasa thought long and hard about which dolls to buy. Saki also seemed very happy with all of her friends around...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hope their party turns out well.)
Doll Festival Day - Early morning
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. Saki still seems to be asleep. Now, to put the new dolls I bought on display!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's take the old ones and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The closer I look, the worse they seem...
Their hair's completely out of place...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And this is it for these dolls...
Maybe I shouldn't just...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait! No, I can't start getting all sentimental now. I'll swap them out for now and deal with them later.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Just have to put them up here...
And done!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I can't wait to see the look on Saki's face!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, what to do with the old ones? They're in tatters, so I could just toss them out but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've always wondered why dad just kept these as they were... They've been kept as clean as they can be but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
Tsukasa, what are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wah!! S-Saki?!
You're up already?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I woke up and couldn't fall back asleep!
I could ask you the same thing, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait... Are those my dolls in your hand?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah! It seems I've been caught red-handed so... Surprise, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Take a look at the top of the stand!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
For the dolls...?
Wait, that's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes! New dolls!
I had Toya help me pick them out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Saki, how are they...?! Could it be that you're so happy that you've been left speechless...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why did you change out my dolls with those...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why? Wait, why?
I thought you'd be happy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm not happy at all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It has to be my dolls! My own dolls! The only set in the whole wide world!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What do you mean?! But they were in tatters before and...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, did you forget about what you did for me that time...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course not! It's still fresh in my mind! That's why I...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! You definitely have! If you did, you never would've done something like this...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I get that you're a forgetter, but I never thought you'd ever forget about that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa... You big, dumb forgetter...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?! How can you..?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly, what's so great about having these old and dirty dolls? Won't everyone make fun of you for that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, that doesn't matter! Plus, Ichi and the others would never do anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just forget it! We're done talking, Tsukasa! At least until you remember what actually happened back then!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I said I still remember!
All of it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you haven't!
Until you actually do, I'm done talking to you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... Fine, be that way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line:
Grrr!
Hmph!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm going to school!
Bye!
se_event_hinamatsuri_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Fine! Bye!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's gotten into Saki...? Why is she so obsessed with her old dolls?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And what did she mean by me not remembering anything? Am I really missing something here...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, there's just no way!
I'll never forget the way I felt after that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But... Why do I suddenly feel doubt welling up inside me?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have no idea...
